description: Stable invalid-endpoint selector defaulting and error normalization: any value other than the exact string vacant (missing key or bogus token) takes the out_of_bounds branch, and both branches normalize the underlying runtime panic into a language-neutral invalid_graph_reference error on stdout without leaking host exception text.

input.scenario: invalid_endpoint key absent -> default out_of_bounds branch still errors cleanly
unrecognized endpoint token falls back to out_of_bounds branch
capitalized Vacant is not an exact match so out_of_bounds branch runs and still errors
